name: Sunlu (Zhuhai Sunlu Industrial Co., Ltd.)
summary: Founded July 2013 in Zhuhai, Guangdong, Sunlu is a high-volume Chinese filament producer with three FDM production bases, 20,000+ tons of cumulative shipments and 36 global distribution points. It sells under its own brand, is well known for its S-series filament dryers, and manufactures for several budget retail labels.

additional_notes: Also produces photopolymer resins and the widely used S-series filament dryers, plus PEI-coated magnetic spring-steel build surfaces (e.g. 235x235 mm) sold separately from the filament line; no individual plate entries exist in this catalog yet, so plate_ids is empty. HQ in Zhuhai/Guangdong with a German branch office. Typical PLA around $15-20/kg (exact figure unverified), placing it on the budget/mid boundary.

provenance.conflicts: Legal entity name is unsettled: LinkedIn lists 'Zhuhai Sunlu Industrial Co., Ltd' while trade sources refer to 'SUNLU (Guangdong) Technology Co., Ltd.'; which is the current registered name is unverified. Which Bambu Lab lines are Sunlu-produced is also unresolved.
